# Document Studio

Reshape and read the data formats work actually arrives in (CSV, Excel, JSON, EPUB and RTF) with a real desktop-app feel, entirely in your browser.

9 tools. Each name opens the tool on gigai.tools, where its page explains how to use it step by step.

| Tool | What it does | Input | Output | Runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [CSV Editor](https://gigai.tools/csv-editor) | Drop or paste a CSV and it opens as a fast, editable spreadsheet grid, edit any cell, add or delete rows and columns, sort a column, search across everything, then export to CSV, JSON or a real Excel.xlsx. Robust quoting-aware parsing, tens of thousands of rows kept smooth, all in your browser and never uploaded. | CSV, TSV, TXT | CSV, JSON, XLSX | Browser |
| [CSV to Excel](https://gigai.tools/csv-to-excel) | Paste CSV or drop a spreadsheet export and download a genuine Excel workbook. The delimiter is auto-detected, a live grid shows exactly what lands in the sheet, and you name the worksheet before you export: all in your browser, never uploaded. | CSV, TSV, TXT | XLSX | Browser |
| [CSV to JSON](https://gigai.tools/csv-to-json) | Paste CSV or drop a spreadsheet export and watch it become clean JSON live. Choose an array of objects or arrays, toggle the header row, opt into number/boolean/null type inference, and switch between pretty and minified, all in your browser, never uploaded. | CSV, TSV, TXT | JSON | Browser |
| [CSV Viewer](https://gigai.tools/csv-viewer) | Drop or paste a CSV and it opens instantly as a clean, sortable, searchable spreadsheet. No editing, no clutter. Sort any column, filter and search across every cell, and read a live column profile that tells you the type, fill rate and numeric range of each field. Delimiter is auto-detected, tens of thousands of rows stay smooth, and everything runs in your browser. Never uploaded. | CSV, TSV, TXT | CSV, JSON | Browser |
| [Document Viewer](https://gigai.tools/document-viewer) | One drop zone for everything. Add a PDF, CSV, Excel workbook, text file, Markdown, EPUB, RTF or image and the viewer works out the format for you and renders a faithful preview right in your browser: page through a PDF, scroll a spreadsheet, read rendered Markdown or an e-book, all without an app, an account or an upload. | PDF, CSV, XLSX, TXT, MD, JSON, EPUB, RTF, PNG, JPG | Original file | Browser |
| [EPUB Viewer](https://gigai.tools/epub-viewer) | Drop an.epub and it opens into a real reader: paginated pages you turn like a book, a clickable table of contents, adjustable font size, and light, sepia or dark themes for comfortable reading. Keyboard arrows flip pages, your place is remembered as you go, and the whole book stays on your device, never uploaded. | EPUB | On-screen reading view | Browser |
| [Excel to CSV](https://gigai.tools/excel-to-csv) | Drop an Excel workbook, choose which sheet to export, and get a clean, properly-escaped CSV live in your browser. Multi-tab.xlsx and legacy.xls files, quoted fields and commas inside cells are all handled, and nothing is ever uploaded. | XLSX, XLS | CSV | Browser |
| [JSON to CSV](https://gigai.tools/json-to-csv) | Paste a JSON array of objects and watch it become a clean CSV live. Flatten nested objects into dotted columns, toggle the header row, and pick comma, semicolon or tab: then copy it or download a.csv, all in your browser and never uploaded. | JSON | CSV, TSV | Browser |
| [RTF Viewer](https://gigai.tools/rtf-viewer) | Got an.rtf file and no app that opens it cleanly? Drop it here, or paste the raw RTF, and read the formatted text instantly, bold, italic, underline and paragraph breaks preserved. Then export the result as tidy HTML or plain TXT. 100% in your browser, no upload, no account, nothing stored. | RTF | HTML, TXT | Browser |
